svg.title: OASIS7 俯视像素世界场景
svg.desc: 320×180 逻辑像素的可复用世界背景。Smelter 占地 48×48，位于 144,64，中心 168,88，入口 168,112；场景不含 Agent、姓名、权限、库存、任务状态或选择标记。道路、矿床与建筑仅供设计示意，不是权威世界位置。
svg.metadata: { "artifact": "oasis7 UI/UE pixel-world design source", "status": "design illustration; not an exported production renderer or authorized world state", "projection": "top-down 2D", "logical_pixel": 1, "tile_size": [ 16, 16 ], "palette": { "ink": "#0b1714", "forest": "#15271f", "ground": "#1e3428", "grass": "#2b4732", "leaf": "#426047", "soil-dark": "#393b2d", "soil": "#565643", "stone": "#7a7656", "machine-dark": "#3d4c4b", "machine": "#5e716c", "machine-light": "#91a39a", "light": "#d6dec0", "ochre": "#997943", "gold": "#d0a85b", "mint-dark": "#60997d", "mint": "#9ec9ac" }, "asset_sizes": { "ground": [ 16, 16 ], "ground-alt": [ 16, 16 ], "grass": [ 16, 16 ], "path": [ 16, 16 ], "ore": [ 16, 16 ], "rock": [ 16, 16 ], "tree": [ 16, 16 ], "scrub": [ 16, 16 ], "smelter": [ 48, 48 ], "depot": [ 32, 32 ], "agent": [ 16, 16 ] }, "constraints": [ "integer rectangles only", "no gradients, curves, diagonals, filters, strokes or opacity", "rasterize at logical size, then upscale by integer nearest-neighbor", "keep identity, provenance, selection, receipts and all UI text outside this world artwork" ], "anchors": { "agent": [ 8, 15 ], "smelter_center": [ 24, 24 ], "smelter_entry": [ 24, 48 ], "depot_center": [ 16, 16 ], "depot_entry": [ 16, 32 ] } }

symbol.desc: 16×16 基础地块；低对比固定像素纹理。
16×16 基础地块变体；不承载资源或运行状态。
16×16 成片草地；固定实色，无透明纹理。
16×16 道路地块；整数拼接，纹理没有方向或物流量含义。
16×16 矿床示意；外观不声明组成、储量、可用输入或授权。
16×16 岩石精灵；阶梯边缘，不投射阴影。
16×16 树冠精灵；俯视阶梯轮廓，无模糊或投影。
16×16 低植被精灵；不参与目标或选中状态。
48×48（3×3 tile）俯视冶炼炉。暖金只表示固定外壳涂装，不表示点火、任务进行中、成功或库存。中心锚点 24,24；底部入口 24,48。
32×32（2×2 tile）仓储建筑示意。没有 Micro Depot 的 active/suspended/depleted 状态、库存或吞吐量含义。中心锚点 16,16；底部入口 16,32。
16×16 Agent 静态设计精灵；普通薄荷色不编码选择、任务或权限。姓名、选择、来源、未知和回执由独立上层文字或标记表达。脚点锚点 8,15。
